card.name: Space before a week number
card.fires_on: The space right after a time word like week, at, by, or for, just before a number of weeks (4, 8, 12, 24, 48). It appears in trial results and treatment-stopping rules.

modes.label: Week label then number

modes.label: Stopping-rule timing
modes.description: After 'at', 'by', 'after' or 'for' when a treatment length in weeks is about to be given.
modes.example: has not achieved an HCV-RNA below the limit of detection of the assay by<< >>24 weeks.
